request_text: Studio-ceramics trade delegation to Tokyo. Flew Cascadia Pacific 51 nonstop (about ten hours) in business on December 31; the director approved business class on November 22 and the agency's frequent-flyer miles are all used up. The 8-hour rule takes effect the day after I left, and I was in the air at midnight, so I trust the new rule applies. Hotels were direct-billed.
